text:
Anna M: Quick proposal — add an opt-in explain flag to /rerank so callers can get per-candidate provenance and compact topology for console and debugging.

Josh L: +1 on explain but worried about payload bloat. We should make it opt-in and sampled. Also prefer a compact format for top-k list.

Priya R: Proposed canonical fields: score (0-1), normalized_score, provenance: model_variant|quant_tag|shard, tokens_used, kv_cache_hit (bool), latency_ms. Also add 'quality_bucket' in {low,mid,high} computed by runtime.

Marco G: Console wants: topk_delta, per-candidate latency, and an abbreviated display string. If full payload arrives, show 'expand' in UI. Need a compact wire format for the initial list.

Liz H: Telemetry note — per-candidate fields increase cardinality. We should sample explains (e.g., per-tenant sampling + error-based sampling). Trace IDs required to join logs.

Anna M: How about query param: ?explain=full|compact|none and header X-Rerank-Explain-Sample: <pct>. Default none. Also add score_units and billing_units in the response for quota accounting.

Josh L: Sketch of compact response:
```
{
  "candidates": [
    {"id":"c1","s":0.87,"n":0.84,"p":"gptr-1q8","t":12,"k":1},
    {"id":"c2","s":0.72,"n":0.71,"p":"gptr-1q8","t":9,"k":0}
  ],
  "meta":{"model_affinity":"gptr-1q8","billing_units":2}
}
```
Fields: s=score, n=normalized_score, p=provenance, t=tokens_used, k=kv_cache_hit

Priya R: For billing, separate 'billing_units' (external billing) and 'internal_compute_units' for infra. Also propose 'candidate_fanout' to count LM calls.

Marco G: For rollouts, console needs 'model_delta' markers when output ordering changes due to model switch, plus 'fallback_reason' when we fall back to cheaper model.

Liz H: Agree on sampling knobs. Also add a telemetry tag 'explain_sample' so downstream can filter.

deploy-bot: canary deployed to staging with explain=true for 1% traffic :rocket:

Anna M: I'll draft an RFC + sample telemetry configs. Thanks everyone :raised_hands:

Josh L: happy to prototype compact encoder.

Priya R: I'll add quota accounting hooks.

Marco G: UI POC next sprint.

Liz H: I'll wire sampling into the observability pipeline.

Anna M: cool. moving to RFC stage.
